summary: Phase 2 VitaGuide+ testing. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases PASSED covering (a) weight/history weekly-insights extension (week_avg_kg, prev_week_avg_kg, week_delta_kg, trend, hint_key, entries_last_week) across all 4 trend branches (down/up/stable/unknown), (b) analyze-meal-photo contract validation (short-image 400 + source-level coach_line key/phrases present — LLM call not exercised by design), (c) regression on /today, /goals, /schedule, /day-plan, /summary, /achievements still 200, (d) seeded profile f97fdefb-… now returns Phase 2 fields (trend='stable', hint_key='stable_is_normal'). Frontend: After forced expo bundler restart (CI mode requires it), wm-weight-toggle + wm-reco-toggle render, collapse/expand verified by hiding/showing wm-history-btn; Recommendations starts collapsed (collapsedReco default=true) — chevron-down visible. coachLineFor map keys are shake1/shake2 in source (bug fix applied).

integration_issues.flow: Weight section state population for seeded profile f97fdefb-…
integration_issues.issue: Backend GET /weight-metabolism/{pid}/weight/history returns current_kg=110.0 and week_avg_kg=110.0 for the seeded profile, but the WM screen shows 'Current —' and the Weekly-Insight block (testID='wm-weekly-insight') is not rendered. The conditional gate {weight?.week_avg_kg !== null && …} never becomes truthy in the page state. This is NOT a Phase 2 regression — it is a frontend-state issue with how /weight/history response is consumed (likely the setWeight call uses a different/incorrect response shape). Recommend the main agent verify the fetch + setState path for the weight history call.

wm-meals-toggle and wm-coach-line-shake1/shake2/small_meal/large_meal cannot be visually verified for the seeded profile because today.meals.length===0 and no active routine is running. Their conditional wrappers therefore never render. Same constraint reported in iter88 — main agent self-test recommended after starting a routine + logging at least one meal.

issues: 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin. Did you mean transformOrigin?' still emitted on every render.
'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' still spamming the console — same as iter88.

action_items: Investigate why /weight/history response is not populating the weight state for profile f97fdefb-… in the WM screen — Current shows '—' and weekly-insight card never renders, even though backend returns full data. Check that the fetch result is mapped/stored under the same key the JSX reads (`weight.week_avg_kg`, `weight.current_kg`).
(Same as iter88) Pre-existing 'transform-origin' DOM-prop warning + raw-text-node-in-<View> warning still pollute the console.

(Optional) For deterministic frontend testing of wm-meals-toggle and the four wm-coach-line-* selectors, seed an active routine + at least one meal_log entry for the test profile so the conditional sections render.
critical_code_review_comments: weight_history weekly-insight logic is correct and well-bounded: stable-band uses strict |delta| < 0.2, down/up branches are mutually exclusive, hint_key mapping is 1:1 with trend. Good.

analyze_meal_photo wraps the coach_line computation in a try/except defaulting to empty string — good resilience, but consider returning a generic fallback line (e.g., 'Mahlzeit eingebucht.') instead of empty so the UI never shows an empty block.

Phase-2 weekly_insight uses Python sort on string dates ('YYYY-MM-DD') — works correctly because ISO-style dates sort lexicographically, but consider using actual datetime objects if formats ever change.
Frontend coachLineFor map now matches backend DAY_PLAN_EVENTS keys (shake1/shake2). Good fix.
Recommendations section default-collapsed (collapsedReco=true) is a sensible UX choice for a long screen and matches the request spec.

success_rate.frontend: Toggles + collapse/expand: 100%. Weekly-insight rendering: blocked by weight-state not populating (not a Phase 2 bug).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Phase 2 (weight/history weekly insights + analyze-meal-photo coach_line contract) fully passes (14/14). Frontend toggles (wm-weight-toggle, wm-reco-toggle) verified working — Recommendations starts collapsed as spec'd. wm-meals-toggle and wm-coach-line-shake1/shake2 require active routine + meals to visually verify (same as iter88). wm-weekly-insight DOM render is blocked by an unrelated frontend-state issue: backend returns current_kg=110 and week_avg_kg=110 for the seeded profile but the WM screen shows '—'; the weight state from /weight/history isn't reaching the JSX gate. Worth a quick fetch/state-shape check by main agent. NOTE: Expo is running in CI mode and does NOT hot-reload, so after any frontend edit run 'sudo supervisorctl restart expo' to pick up changes (this was needed during this iteration to see the new toggle TouchableOpacities).
rca of the issue: wm-weekly-insight rendering miss — RCA: not a backend bug (verified via curl: current_kg=110.0, week_avg_kg=110.0, trend='stable', hint_key='stable_is_normal'). The frontend never renders the conditional <View testID='wm-weekly-insight'> because `weight?.week_avg_kg` stays null/undefined in the React state. Reproduction: open /weight-metabolism with profile_id=f97fdefb-…; observe Weight card shows 'Current —' and no weekly card. Mitigation: main agent should confirm the setWeight(...) call assigns the full /weight/history response object (not just `entries`) and verify there is no destructuring that drops the new fields.
